entries.test: Whether the Mahdavi et al. study (2025) concludes that LLMs fall short on Olympiad-level math and often reach correct answers through heuristics rather than sound reasoning, in line with Marcus and Davis's essay.
entries.note: The study's conclusions are quoted in the post, so this mainly checks how Marcus characterises them.

entries.test: Whether, as of April 2025, no GPT-5-level model had shipped, several labs offered models of similar capability, API prices were being cut competitively, and frontier labs reported losses or only modest profits.
entries.note: This bundles several parts together. The drafter's 'conditions' field lists parts of the claim, not antecedents.

entries.test: Whether credible reporting or official statements show that the April 2025 tariff formula was partly derived from LLM output and contained a calculation error.
entries.note: 'Devastated the global economy' is hyperbole. The testable core is the LLM origin and the math error, and the LLM link was only speculated in public reporting.
This is a judgment of character with no agreed test.
